anya: Quick debrief from the midnight hardening run in eu-west-1 — we lost join progress on ~6 GPU nodes during the firewall swap, warm-pool stayed under desired size for ~7m.
lee: Was this the adhoc hardening or the scheduled run?
anya: Scheduled. We applied the new stateful rule set -> default-deny then reverted. We also rotated a keystore endpoint as part of the same window which probably didn't help.
deploy-bot: [ci] run=hardening-eu-2026-03-24 id=hn-221
deploy-bot: nodes_evicted=6 warm_rejoin_lag=420s keystore_errors=31 conntrack_drop=1.8k
tom: Paste from natgw: ```
2026-03-24T00:42:11Z natgw: conntrack_alloc_fail threshold=65536 current=65536
2026-03-24T00:42:12Z natgw: nat_port_exhaustion warn=true used=98%
```
anya: And keystore proxy logs showed handshake timeouts: ```
2026-03-24T00:42:13Z keystore-proxy: rpc error: code=4 desc=\"deadline exceeded\" shard=eu-west-1-a
2026-03-24T00:42:14Z keystore-proxy: upstream=HSM-proxy backpressure=true
```
sre-ali: Sounds like a perfect storm: conntrack cap hit -> retries -> more handshakes to keystore -> per-shard QPS limits trigger -> 503s/timeouts -> kubelet join times out.
lee: Audit saw gaps too. audit-bot flagged missing spans around node-join events. We briefly had sampling set to 10% for rollout tests, which hid the cascade.
audit-bot: ALERT: missing-audit-spans namespace=node-join window=180s approx_spans_missing=~320
tom: Immediate fixes we tested in staging that worked: 1) bump conntrack limits on the NATGW and increase ephemeral ports; 2) temporarily raise keystore shard qps and HSM proxy buffer; 3) pre-create 2 warm nodes per AZ 10m before firewall change; 4) keep audit sampling at 100% during the operation.
anya: Draft runbook snippet (for the maintenance ticket):
  - pre-scale keystore shards: autoscale-override to +50% 10m prior
  - apply natgw conntrack template: 
    - conntrack_max=131072
    - ephemeral_ports=40000-65000
  - pre-warm: create 2 ephemeral warm nodes/az 15m prior
  - run single-AZ canary then full roll
  - if warm_rejoin_lag >180s or keystore_errors >20 -> rollback firewall immediately
tom: Config snippet for terraform (example): ```hcl
resource \"nat_gateway_config\" \"eu_test\" {
  conntrack_max = 131072
  ephemeral_ports = \"40000-65000\"
}
```
sre-ali: Fallback: if we still see sustained join failures, enable cross-region read-only keystore routing to eu-central-1 for node bootstrap (reduces latency but keeps bootstrap succeed).
lee: Cost calc: pre-warm + shard bump ~ $90/hr for the window. We should include that in the ticket and tag finance for chargeback.
audit-bot: NOTE: set audit retention for this run to 7d and attach full spans to ticket for PM/SEC review.
anya: I can own the run. I'll open INFRA-1402 and schedule for 2026-03-26 02:00Z maintenance window. Will add rollback playbook and attach run artifacts.
deploy-bot: scheduled=INFRA-1402 window=2026-03-26T02:00Z duration=45m owner=anya
lee: One operational nicety: add a keystore autoscale cooldown of 20m to avoid an immediate post-apply scale-down and second blip.
sre-ali: Also gate the firewall apply on a short pre-check: conntrack headroom >=30% and keystore healthy_shards >=3.
tom: After canary we'll collect: natgw conntrack hist, keystore-proxy traces, HSM proxy counters, kubelet join traces, and full audit span dump. Set alerts to page if keystore_errors > 15 in 60s.
audit-bot: will attach missing-span list to INFRA-1402 when available.
anya: Thanks all. I'll post the runbook and checklist in the ticket and ping sec for a quick review. :rocket:
